FND-C01.sql: SELECT itm_no, TRIM(itm_nm), MAX(fd_nast_suma) AS fd_nast_suma, COUNT(*) AS "클래스수", CAST(ROUND(fd_nast_suma/100000000.0) AS INTEGER) || '억원' AS "순자산_억원" FROM public_funds  WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rptt_ksd_itm_no),'KR0000000000'), printf('%08d', CAST(or_co_xtn_itt_cd AS INTEGER)) || '/' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN length(trim(mtco_itm_no)) >= 7 THEN trim(mtco_itm_no) ELSE substr('0000000' || trim(mtco_itm_no), -7) END, itm_no)) HAVING MAX(fd_nast_suma) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(fd_nast_suma) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5

FND-C02.sql: SELECT or_co_rwrd_r + sale_co_rwrd_r + trusc_rwrd_r + ofwk_trus_rwrd_r as total_commission_rate, or_co_xtn_itt_cd, itm_nm, COUNT(*) AS "클래스수", MAX(fd_nast_suma) AS fd_nast_suma, CAST(ROUND(fd_nast_suma/100000000.0) AS INTEGER) || '억원' AS "순자산_억원" FROM public_funds WHERE TRIM(or_co_xtn_itt_cd) IN ('00040010', '00080135', '00080134', '00080168', '00040092') AND sale_yn = '판매중' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' AND (or_co_rwrd_r IS NOT NULL OR sale_co_rwrd_r IS NOT NULL OR trusc_rwrd_r IS NOT NULL OR ofwk_trus_rwrd_r IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rptt_ksd_itm_no),'KR0000000000'), printf('%08d', CAST(or_co_xtn_itt_cd AS INTEGER)) || '/' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN length(trim(mtco_itm_no)) >= 7 THEN trim(mtco_itm_no) ELSE substr('0000000' || trim(mtco_itm_no), -7) END, itm_no)) ORDER BY fd_nast_suma DESC LIMIT 30

FND-R02.q: 지난 1주일 수익률이 가장 높은 공모펀드 알려줘
FND-R02.sql: SELECT itm_no, TRIM(itm_nm), MAX(fd_mm1_ern_r) AS fd_mm1_ern_r, COUNT(*) AS "클래스수", zrin_attr_nms FROM public_funds   WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rptt_ksd_itm_no),'KR0000000000'), printf('%08d', CAST(or_co_xtn_itt_cd AS INTEGER)) || '/' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN length(trim(mtco_itm_no)) >= 7 THEN trim(mtco_itm_no) ELSE substr('0000000' || trim(mtco_itm_no), -7) END, itm_no)) HAVING MAX(fd_mm1_ern_r) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(fd_mm1_ern_r) > -100 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5

FND-R03.q: 기준가가 높은 순서로 좋은 펀드 알려줘
FND-R03.sql: SELECT itm_no, TRIM(itm_nm), fd_daily_bas_dt, fd_nast_suma, fd_price_bas_dt, fd_last_dstb_r, CAST(ROUND(fd_nast_suma/100000000.0) AS INTEGER) || '억원' AS "순자산_억원" FROM public_funds WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' AND fd_price_bas_dt IS NOT NULL AND fd_price_bas_dt > 0 ORDER BY fd_price_bas_dt DESC LIMIT 5

FND-R04.q: 내년에 수익률이 가장 좋을 공모펀드 추천해줘
FND-R04.sql: SELECT itm_no, TRIM(itm_nm), MAX(fd_yr1_ern_r) AS fd_yr1_ern_r, COUNT(*) AS "클래스수", zrin_attr_nms FROM public_funds  WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' AND mat_dt > 20290822 AND itm_no NOT IN ('KR5157450126', 'KR5153450511', 'KR5119470012') GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rptt_ksd_itm_no),'KR0000000000'), printf('%08d', CAST(or_co_xtn_itt_cd AS INTEGER)) || '/' || COALESCE(CASE WHEN length(trim(mtco_itm_no)) >= 7 THEN trim(mtco_itm_no) ELSE substr('0000000' || trim(mtco_itm_no), -7) END, itm_no)) HAVING MAX(fd_yr1_ern_r) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(fd_yr1_ern_r) > -100 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5

OFFICIAL-002.sql: SELECT DISTINCT public_funds.itm_no, itm_nm, estb_dt, redemption_fee_desc, redemption_prohibited, redemption_pay_rule, total_fee_pct, sale_fee_pct, mgmt_fee_pct, trust_fee_pct, admin_fee_pct, class_desc_ko, mgmt_co_nm, mother_fund_names_raw FROM public_funds JOIN ext_fund_page ON ext_fund_page.itm_no = public_funds.itm_no WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND (REPLACE(itm_nm,' ','') LIKE '%국민성장펀드%' AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모') LIMIT 30

CROSS-001.sql: SELECT '국내 ETF' AS 구분, pd_abrv_nm, du_er_1y FROM domestic_etfs e JOIN ext_etf_holdings h ON h.etf_code = e.pd_itm_no WHERE h.constituent IN ('삼성전자', '삼성전자 (Security)', '005930') AND pd_grp_no = 'ETF' AND du_er_1y IS NOT NULL AND du_er_1y > -100 UNION ALL SELECT '공모펀드', it.mtco_itm_nm, fd.fd_yr1_ern_r FROM public_funds it JOIN ext_fund_holdings fd ON fd.grp = it.mtco_itm_no AND fd.or_co = it.or_co_xtn_itt_cd WHERE sale_yn = '판매중' AND (fd.holding_nm IN ('삼성전자', '삼성전자 (Security)', '005930') AND prvo_pbff_desc = '공모' AND fd_yr1_ern_r IS NOT NULL AND fd_yr1_ern_r > -100) ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
